'''Exander''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Overseer of the [[VerveGen Corporation]] . He was killed when the [[VerveGen Corporation building]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] was infiltrated by [[Cipher Nine]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|Cleaning Up VerveGen|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>
